answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ledge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The pearl holds work receipts rather than names, so the mirror of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
